title: Claude Code, Codex & Gemini CLI: Same Task, Two Fixes, One Login Block
description:
Three AI coding tools received the same small task. Two completed it; one was blocked by personal account login. Google ended Login with Google support for personal Gemini CLI accounts in June 2026; enterprise access and API keys have separate paths. Follow the starter files, diffs, and later acceptance tests to build a comparison method of your own.
This is one small hands-on demonstration. Default models and account conditions differed, so these results are not a capability ranking. Reported usage estimates are not actual bills.

v30014.text: The task is small: split an integer amount among several people.

v30015.text: Split 100 cents among three people. The total must remain 100.

v30016.text: Give any extra cents to earlier people in array order.

v30017.text: The rule is simple to grasp and makes errors easy to spot.

v30018.text: If the shares do not add up, the function has not done its job.

v30021.text: The starter code divides by the count, then gives everyone that amount.

v30022.text: It works when divisible, but may over- or under-allocate otherwise.
